description: Get live shipping prices for one parcel from several carriers (Canada Post, UPS, FedEx and others). No account needed. Give the origin and destination postal or ZIP codes and the weight in kilograms (convert pounds and inches first); the box size is optional and a 30 x 20 x 10 cm box is assumed when it is missing. Returns up to 6 of the cheapest services with price and estimated transit time, and a link that opens the same quote on the website, where the label can be bought. Prices are the public rates at the moment of the quote. If the user is signed in, compare_shipping_rates returns their own account prices instead.

from_country.description: Origin country, ISO alpha-2. Defaults to "CA".

from_postal.description: Origin postal or ZIP code, e.g. "H2X 1Y1".

lang.description: Language of the answer. Defaults to the user's locale, then to the site's language.

to_country.description: Destination country, ISO alpha-2. Defaults to "CA".

to_postal.description: Destination postal or ZIP code, e.g. "M5V 2T6".

weight_kg.description: Parcel weight in kilograms. Must be greater than 0.

name: get_shipping_quote
title: Get a shipping quote
